title: Sampling Distributions
overview: Connect samples, statistics and repeated sampling.

concepts.name: Population
concepts.definition: The full set of units about which an inference is made.

concepts.name: Sample
concepts.definition: A subset observed from the population.

concepts.name: Sampling Distribution
concepts.definition: The distribution of a statistic over repeated samples.

sections.title: Why repeated samples matter
sections.body: Different random samples produce different statistics. A sampling distribution describes that variation.

activities.title: Predict before calculating
activities.prompt: If sample size increases, what do you expect to happen to the variability of the sample mean?

quiz.question: What does a sampling distribution describe?
options: Variation of a statistic across repeated samples
Values of every individual in a population
quiz.rationale: A sampling distribution concerns the behavior of a statistic across repeated samples.
